objective: Auditar en solo lectura la identidad y permisos efectivos de la conexion canonica HRLectura sobre EDARSAHUB y especificamente dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig antes de decidir el canal de escritura para la migracion Gate8F. No ejecutar DDL/DML, no modificar secretos, no tocar Produccion.

queries.name: identity_and_database
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS db_user

queries.name: gate8f_target_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','U') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS table_present, COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','OBJECT','SELECT'),0) AS can_select, COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','OBJECT','INSERT'),0) AS can_insert, COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','OBJECT','UPDATE'),0) AS can_update, COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','OBJECT','DELETE'),0) AS can_delete

queries.name: database_writer_roles
queries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(IS_ROLEMEMBER('db_datareader'),0) AS db_datareader, COALESCE(IS_ROLEMEMBER('db_datawriter'),0) AS db_datawriter, COALESCE(IS_ROLEMEMBER('db_ddladmin'),0) AS db_ddladmin, COALESCE(IS_ROLEMEMBER('db_owner'),0) AS db_owner
